name: ktypechecker_test.k
model:
x:Int = 10

y:Bool = true

z:String = "hello"

a:Int = 42

b:Real = 3.14E0

c:String = "world"

d:Bool = false

e:Int = x + 5

f:String = z + " there"

g:Bool = a > 0

req x > 0

req y || d

req e > a
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (x Int)(y Bool)(z String)(a Int)(b Real)(c String)(d Bool)(e Int)(f String)(g Bool)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.x: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.y: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!y ((this Ref)) Bool
  (y (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.z: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!z ((this Ref)) String
  (z (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.a: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!a ((this Ref)) Int
  (a (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.b: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!b ((this Ref)) Real
  (b (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.c: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!c ((this Ref)) String
  (c (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.d: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!d ((this Ref)) Bool
  (d (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.e: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!e ((this Ref)) Int
  (e (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.f: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!f ((this Ref)) String
  (f (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.g: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!g ((this Ref)) Bool
  (g (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!x this) 10)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!y this) true)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 0) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!z this) "hello")
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 0) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!a this) 42)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 0) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!b this) 3.1400000000000000)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv5 0) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 6: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv6 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!c this) "world")
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv6 0) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 7: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv7 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!d this) false)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv7 0) :named _xkassert6))

; --- Invariant 8: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv8 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!e this) (+ (TopLevelDeclarations!x this) 5))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv8 0) :named _xkassert7))

; --- Invariant 9: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv9 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!f this) (str.++ (TopLevelDeclarations!z this) " there"))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv9 0) :named _xkassert8))

; --- Invariant 10: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv10 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!g this) (> (TopLevelDeclarations!a this) 0))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv10 0) :named _xkassert9))

; --- Invariant 11: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv11 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (TopLevelDeclarations!x this) 0)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv11 0) :named _xkassert10))

; --- Invariant 12: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv12 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or (TopLevelDeclarations!y this) (TopLevelDeclarations!d this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv12 0) :named _xkassert11))

; --- Invariant 13: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv13 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (TopLevelDeclarations!e this) (TopLevelDeclarations!a this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv13 0) :named _xkassert12))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
  )
)
